summary: Sporting News previews the sportsbook bonuses and promo codes expected when legal online sports betting launches in Vermont in January 2024. It details welcome and prelive offers from FanDuel, DraftKings, BetMGM, Fanatics and ESPN Bet, plus possible entrants Caesars and BetRivers. It also explains types of promos, common terms and conditions, and how to claim bonuses.
one_line: Guide to expected Vermont online sportsbook promos and welcome offers ahead of the Jan. 11, 2024 launch, with offer details, pros/cons and terms.
key_facts: Vermont's online sports betting launch is scheduled for January 2024, and the new law authorizes up to six sites; five operators applied for licenses.
FanDuel, DraftKings and Fanatics are already scheduled to launch in Vermont on Jan. 11, 2024; BetMGM and ESPN Bet are also applicants.

FanDuel's prelive Early Sign Up Special gives $100 in Bonus Bets for registering before Jan. 10, 2024 at 11:59 p.m. ET, and its welcome offer is bet $5, get $200 in Bonus Bets whether the bet wins or loses, for a possible $300 total.
FanDuel requires a first deposit of at least $10 and a qualifying bet of at least $5, and Bonus Bets expire after seven days.
DraftKings' prelive offer gives $200 in Bonus Bets as eight $25 Bonus Bets, but accepting it makes users ineligible for the later welcome offer.
DraftKings' welcome offer is worth up to $1,200: a $50 Bonus Bet for a $5 deposit, $150 in Bonus Bets for a $5 first wager, and a 20% deposit match up to $1,000 with a 25x wagering requirement.
BetMGM's welcome offer returns lost first bets as Bonus Bets up to $1,500 within 24 hours of settlement using the code SPORTSPICK, with a minimum $10 deposit and seven days to use the bets.
Fanatics Sportsbook's Vermont welcome offer is still TBD; elsewhere it has offered bet $5 get $200, five $10 bets over five days totaling $200, and Fanatics Store credit.

ESPN Bet launched its rebranded site, formerly Barstool Sportsbook, in 17 states in Nov. 2023; elsewhere it offered a 100% deposit match up to $1,000 with a 20x wagering requirement, or $200 in four $50 Bonus Bets.
Caesars Sportsbook, with code NEWS1000, offers up to a $1,000 Bonus Bet if the first bet loses, delivered within two days and valid for 14 days.
BetRivers Sportsbook, with code SPORTSRIV, offers a first-bet refund up to $500 as a Bonus Bet usable within 30 days on odds of -200 or longer; the amount may differ in Vermont.
Winning bets placed with Bonus Bets pay only the winnings, not the stake, and each sportsbook typically allows one bonus per customer, sometimes one per household.
Vermont has no teams in the four major US pro leagues, but residents often support Boston teams such as the Red Sox, Celtics, Bruins and Patriots.
